title: Better Lesson Narration, With a Quota Safety Net | vitalii.no
description:
Robotic text-to-speech voices are fine for skimming, but they make sitting through a full listening lesson tiring, especially when you are trying to actually absorb a new language.

mini.vitalii.no's Norwegian narration now defaults to Google Cloud's Chirp 3 HD voices (Kore for one register, Charon for another) instead of the older edge-tts voices. An API key restricted to that single API tracks usage against a monthly character cap, keeping the upgrade inside Google's free tier. The worker's UI (worker/public/app.js, index.html) now shows which voice engine narrated a given clip.

When a topic's narration would push past that free cap, the runner (runner/runner.py) quietly falls back to the previous voice for that clip and flags it to be regenerated in Chirp 3 once the quota resets. Listening sessions sound noticeably closer to a real newsreader by default, and a busy month degrades gracefully instead of breaking the pipeline.
